messages.subject: Release of seewave 2.0.5
parts:
Dear seewave users,

A new minor version of seewave (2.0.5) has been pushed to CRAN right
now. The version of each OS should be available soon.

Please see the changes listed below.

Enjoy,

Jerome

---

OTHER CHANGES
o autoc(): a bug fixed when using 'threshold'.
o drawfilter(): a bug of the axis labels fixed.
o fma(): slighty improved by trying to remove DC component.
o fund(): the default value of 'fmax' is now f/2.
o NDSI(): the argument 'anthrophony' is renamed 'anthropophony'.
o spectro(): a bug introduced in the last version regarding the display
of the time axis fixed.
